_comment: Manual description overrides for ps_skill_db.json. Keyed by Hercules constant.
_comment2: Fields present here replace the scraped value for that key only (description and/or levels).
_comment3: This file is NOT regenerated by import_ps_skill_db.py — edits persist across rescrapes.
_comment4: An entry for a constant the scrape does not know ADDS that skill (see PS_MC_TOOLMASTERY, from the 2026-08-09 Merchant rework, not yet in the scraped PS skill DB).
_comment5: A "_why" field inside an entry is documentation only: the loader merges it into the record and nothing reads it.

KN_SPEARBOOMERANG._why: The scrape names skill 59 'Sonic Wave' (a Rune Knight skill, RK_SONICWAVE 2002) but its own description and 150-350% ATK table are Spear Boomerang's. wiki.payonstories.com/Knight lists 'Spear Boomerang' and /Sonic_Wave is a 404, so the scraped name is wrong. A player reported searching the picker for it and finding nothing (2026-09-24).
KN_SPEARBOOMERANG.name: Spear Boomerang

NJ_KIRIKAGE.description: Strikes a target with an attack whose range is equal to the caster's Shadow Jump range. Shadow Slash no longer possesses the capability to land critical strikes. However, when paired with the platinum skill - Shadow's Within, critical hits become a possibility.

SM_TWOHANDSWORD.name: Blade Mastery
SM_TWOHANDSWORD.description: Increases damage when meleeing with a One-Handed Sword, Dagger or Two-Handed Sword class weapon (+4 ATK per level). PS Knight rework: Sword Mastery and Two-Hand Sword Mastery were both removed; Blade Mastery replaces them.

AM_AXEMASTERY.name: Transmutation
AM_AXEMASTERY.description: While wielding an Axe or a Sword, increases ASPD and MATK by 1% per skill level (up to 10% each at Level 10). Reworked from Axe Mastery in the 2026-08-09 Alchemist rework — it no longer grants flat ATK; flat Axe/Mace ATK for the Merchant line now comes from Tool Mastery.

MC_LOUD.name: Crazy Uproar
MC_LOUD.description: Adds 3 x SkillLevel soft DEF to the caster and 2 x SkillLevel soft DEF to party members, and grants the caster +1 STR and +1 VIT per skill level for the duration. Requires Blunt Mastery 5.

MC_CARTREVOLUTION.name: Cart Revolution
MC_CARTREVOLUTION.description: Swings the cart at the target for 50% x SkillLevel ATK (250% at Level 5). Deals full damage regardless of cart weight. Moved from a platinum quest skill into the regular skill tree; requires Pushcart 3 and Crazy Uproar 2.

MC_PUSHCART.description: Enables the use of a Pushcart. Condensed into 5 ranks: 80/85/90/95/100% movement speed.

PS_MC_TOOLMASTERY.name: Tool Mastery
PS_MC_TOOLMASTERY.description: Merchant weapon mastery. Adds 4 x SkillLevel Mastery ATK when wielding an Axe or a Mace.

PS_BS_ZENYPINCHER.description: While active, Mammonite no longer consumes Zeny and its damage becomes 100 + 25 x SkillLevel% ATK instead of 100 + 50 x SkillLevel% (350% instead of 600% at Level 10). Retuned by the 2026-08-09 Merchant rework from the old flat 40%-damage penalty.

BS_ADRENALINE.description: Increases ASPD for the caster and nearby party members with any melee weapon: 30%/20% with Maces and Axes, 20%/10% with other melee weapons. Duration 60/120/180/240/300 seconds — no longer extended by Hilt Binding.

SM_SWORD.name: Blade Mastery
SM_SWORD.description: Increases damage when meleeing with a One-Handed Sword, Dagger or Two-Handed Sword class weapon (+4 ATK per level). PS: Blade Mastery replaced Sword Mastery and Two-Hand Sword Mastery outright. For Rogues it also grants a 7% x SkillLevel chance to Double Attack with swords (requires Double Attack as well). Stored under the SM_SWORD key for jobs whose tree carried Sword Mastery.
